title: 2 New Townhomes, Minutes to Broadway | Sleeps 16
description:
- 2 townhomes, right next to each other
- 8 total bedrooms, sleeping 16 guests
- Newly built with chic southern-inspired design
- Modern, fully equipped kitchen with an island with barstool seating
- Each with 4 bedrooms, 3 full bathrooms
- Covered balcony with a spacious lounge seating area

The space
Welcome to 98 Degrees & The Stage by AvantStay! These two stunning and newly built townhomes are right next to each other, with a combined total of 8 bedrooms, sleeping 16 guests—an ideal option for groups looking to spread out.

Each 3-story retreat is as lively and inviting as Nashville itself, combining modern design with Southern-inspired style. As you step inside, the bright and open living spaces greet you with chic design. Kick back and relax on a plush sectional after a day of Nashville adventures. The large, modern kitchens feature an island with barstool seats, stainless steel appliances, and sleek finishes. For those balancing work and play, each home includes a desk vanity—ideal for catching up on emails or getting your glam on before a night out on the town.

Both townhomes have the same four-bedroom layout, each curated with a touch of Southern flair. The primary suite is a private retreat, featuring a king bed, TV, and an ensuite bathroom. On the second floor, you’ll find two equally charming bedrooms—one with a king bed and the other with a queen bed. Both bedrooms have a TV and share a hallway bathroom. The fourth bedroom offers a built-in bunk bed and its own ensuite bathroom, providing flexible sleeping arrangements.

The living space continues outside on the covered balcony, where a lounge seating area awaits. Whether you’re starting your day with coffee or ending it with a craft cocktail, this space is made for relaxing all day long.

Book 98 Degrees & The Stage, the perfect home base for your next Music City getaway!

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we’re at your fingertips!

East Nashville is one of Nashville's oldest neighborhoods, located just across the Cumberland River. Known for its eclectic and artsy atmosphere, you'll find some of the city's best restaurants, live music venues, shopping, and easy access to Nissan Stadium. Bonus: all of the excitement of Broadway is just a 10-minute Uber drive away. Don't be surprised if you see one of your favorite musicians walking around this neighborhood, as many of them call it home!

Experience Nashville, AvantStay style!
